item.title: Breakout Session: Post Quantum Cryptography for Hardware Wallets
item.description: For slides, please see the ‘Extra Info’ tab Why act now The Bitcoin community’s perspective on PQ has clearly evolved — not because a quantum computer is coming tomorrow, but because a non-zero probability creates fear, and if trust erodes, that must be addressed. Migration requires picking the algorithm and answering broader questions: What does it mean for blockchains (block size, etc.)? What’s the timeline and execution plan? This session focuses mostly on the algorithm choice, given its impact on hardware wallets.
